profile: ARJ at offset zero, one volume, fixed main prefixes of 30 or 34 bytes and member prefixes of 30 or 46 bytes, zero extension chains, STORED ordinary member reads; known compressed methods 1–4 support metadata only.

grammar.authority: Historical upstream open-source ARJ serialization and reader; no normative published specification established.

corroboration.role: Independent reader reference only; no copied source implementation.

native.imageScope: Local test-tools snapshots, not public pullable complete producer pins. Signed APT installation changed the base filesystem.

limits.network: none for producer; acquisition only network-enabled

native.proof: Native ARJ test and extraction plus independent 7zip extraction compare exact authored file sets and every original byte. Explicit emptydir appears as a type3 zero-payload native header and both extracted directories; actual main and tiny.txt comments match authored CRLF bytes.
wireObservations: All genuine main headers have a fixed 34-byte prefix and all member headers a 46-byte prefix.
All genuine structural extension lengths are zero.
Requested method 1 compresses only many.bin; small members use method 0.
The genuine file-type-3 emptydir has stored and original size zero.
An interim successful add with -jzFILE left member comments empty. The final explicit c -jzFILE step populates the tiny.txt comment and preserves all original payloads.

negativeReceipts.error: arj a with literal emptydir expands to emptydir/* and fails because directory is empty; no fixture copied.
negativeReceipts.repair: Literal argv emptydi? selects only the authored directory record, no shell.

limitsOfEvidence: Genuine fixtures cover decoder revision 11, 34-byte main prefixes and 46-byte member prefixes. Authored controls cover the 30-byte prefix layout; no original historical producer was run for that layout.
No compressed payload decoding, encryption, SFX, extensions, multivolume, recovery, special-file or general ARJ conformance claim.

benchmark.scope: Six fixed-native-original lanes with full byte preflight; cold index, Blob selected range, full/prefix CRC and pending range have different work/integrity scopes. No universal performance claim.
